title: Add Structured Request Logging Middleware with Correlation IDs
description: Introduces a lightweight logging middleware that assigns a unique correlation ID to each incoming request and logs method, URL, status, response time, and error details in JSON format. This improves observability, aids debugging, and integrates with existing logging infrastructure without adding dependencies.
testCases: Verify that each request receives a unique correlation ID header (X-Correlation-ID) and that the ID is attached to the request object
Confirm that logs are emitted as valid JSON containing method, url, status, responseTime, and correlationId
Ensure that error responses still include the correlation ID and are logged with error details
acceptance: All tests pass; middleware adds X-Correlation-ID header, logs correctly formatted JSON for successful and error responses, and does not affect existing route handling or performance benchmarks.
reason: Enhanced observability is critical for production stability and faster incident resolution. Providing correlation IDs across services enables end‑to‑end tracing, while structured logs simplify log aggregation and analysis, aligning with the framework's stability focus.
